common_evaluation.rule: Only games with all five base models and the already-fitted ensemble available are ranked.
common_evaluation.ensemble_eligibility: The 2023 season is excluded from the six-model leaderboard because no earlier out-of-fold season existed to fit ensemble weights.

chronology.base_models: Every fitted model uses only seasons earlier than its evaluation season.
chronology.ensemble: For season S, weights use only complete out-of-fold predictions from seasons earlier than S; no evaluated-season games choose weights.
chronology.fresh_2027: Previously inspected diagnostic sample, never called an untouched holdout.

overlap_disclosure: The models are separately specified but not statistically independent. M1, M2, M3 and M5 share Elo-derived information; M2, M4 and M5 share team-efficiency/Four-Factor inputs; M3 and M5 share inferred player/rotation features.

m1_elo.label: M1 · Elo baseline
m1_elo.technique: Chronological Elo with home court, rest, prior-season SRS shrinkage and score heuristic

m2_science.label: M2 · Basketball Science
m2_science.technique: Fixed-L2 logistic regression fitted only on earlier seasons

m3_player_roster.label: M3 · Player / Roster
m3_player_roster.technique: Fixed-L2 roster-aware logistic regression fitted only on earlier seasons
m3_player_roster.availability: Historical and live availability/minutes are explicitly inferred unless a separately timestamped official sidecar exists

m5_regularized_ml.label: M5 · Regularized ML
m5_regularized_ml.technique: Fixed-L2 multivariable logistic model; gradient boosting rejected to avoid unnecessary complexity and unstable validation

m6_ensemble.label: M6 · Nested weighted ensemble
m6_ensemble.technique: Non-negative weights summing to one, chosen on earlier out-of-fold seasons only by Brier score

v8_combined.scope: Same common-game sample; earlier regularized Elo/player/team/rest/continuity model

v6_locked_blend.scope: Legacy untouched 2025–26 season only; not directly rankable against the multi-season common leaderboard

slices.early_season: Either team had fewer than 10 games at tipoff.
slices.high_roster_change: Pregame inferred prior-rotation replacement uncertainty at least 0.25; injuries and trades can be confounded.

player_stat_policy.rule: Only players with observed minutes > 0 are scored; DNP and absent rows are excluded.

limitations: No betting-market inputs and no claim of betting advantage.
Historical player availability is inferred rather than an official injury archive.
The five models overlap in inputs and should not be described as independent evidence.
Historical M4 uses 400 seeded simulations per game for tractability; locked live forecasts use the daily workflow's larger configured simulation count.
Confidence intervals describe sampling uncertainty, not all data/provider/model uncertainty.
No model is promoted automatically, regardless of leaderboard rank.
